summary: A notice from the Network Information Center that the ARC PDP-10 system at SRI would be unavailable from Friday, November 17 to Sunday, November 26, 1972, for hardware work. It explains the schedule and says a login message will remind users.

eli5.summary: A shop tells customers it will be closed for over a week for repairs, and puts a sign up in advance.

subtitle: Schedule notice for ARC system downtime during Thanksgiving 1972

tldr.problem: The ARC PDP-10 system at SRI needs extensive hardware maintenance.
tldr.mechanism: The system will be taken offline for over nine days to allow hardware team work with minimal impact on users (only three working days).
tldr.outcome: Users are notified in advance via RFC and login messages about unavailability from November 17 to November 26.

today: RFC 416 announced scheduled maintenance for the ARC system in 1972. It is a historical administrative notice.

sections.title: ARC System Downtime Notice
sections.content: The ARC PDP-10 system, operated by the Network Information Center (NIC) at Stanford Research Institute, will be unavailable for all users from Friday, November 17 at 6:00 pm PST through Sunday, November 26 at 10:00 pm PST, 1972. This notice announces the schedule to network users, and login messages will be sent starting about November 6 to inform all users.
sections.eli5: A shared computer on the network will be shut down for over a week so people can fix its hardware.

sections.title: Maintenance Work
sections.content: During the downtime, the hardware team will perform nine days of work including: removing the Bryant disk and controller; moving the Tasker display system and DEC dispack equipment to new locations; conducting drum maintenance and training; redoing power cabling to the drum; installing new signal cables; debugging the parity checker; checking all main signal levels in the XCORE memory interface; wiring the parity bit through the Cybernex interface; and building a wall for the next dispack location.
sections.eli5: Workers will remove old equipment, move and rewire devices, fix checking systems, and prepare space for new equipment.

sections.title: Impact on Users
sections.content: The downtime stretches from Friday evening through the following Sunday evening, spanning nine calendar days but affecting only three working days (Monday through Wednesday). This schedule allows hardware work while minimizing the impact on users.
sections.eli5: The timing is chosen to include a weekend so most working days are not affected.
